title: Business Analyst :: Tallahassee, FL (Onsite)
description:
Business Analyst

Location: Tallahassee, FL

Duration: 8 months, Onsite

Scope of Services:

The advanced business analyst will collaborate with subject matter experts and stakeholders to translate needs into actionable requirements. Responsibilities include conducting user needs assessments, maintaining relationships, and preparing documentation to support project funding and decision-making.

Primary Job Duties/Tasks:

  • Research and document business processes and their inter-relationships.
  • Collaborate to develop technical specifications, use cases, and business rules.
  • Plan and implement various testing for new and existing functionalities.
  • Assist in business process redesign and documentation.
  • Identify process improvements and design new processes.
  • Facilitate work sessions to prioritize requirements.
  • Prepare comprehensive documentation for funding decisions.

Job Specific Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities (KSAs):

  • Proficiency in research, business analysis, and process modeling.
  • Experience with System Analysis & Design and software development lifecycle.
  • Ability to facilitate workshops and meetings.
  • Technical knowledge of IT infrastructure and software development practices.
  • Ability to produce thorough functional documentation.
  • Skill in developing business cases and conducting data analysis.

Additional Skills:

  • Advanced skills with Microsoft products: SharePoint, Teams, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Power BI, DevOPS, and Project.
  • Ability to relate to stakeholders' needs and document their requirements.
  • Adaptability to changing demands in a dynamic environment.

Experience:

  • Minimum of five years in business process and systems analysis.
  • Proficiency in process mapping/modeling with tools such as Visio.
  • Experience with Microsoft DevOps is highly desired.
  • Knowledge of data migration and change management is required.

Education:

  • Bachelor's or master's degree in Business Administration, Communication, Information Systems, or related field required.
  • Certification in relevant fields like CSM, CBAP, PMI-PBA, or PMP is desired but not required.

title: Senior DDI (DNS/DHCP/IPAM) Engineer :: REMOTE
description:
Senior DDI (DNS/DHCP/IPAM) Engineer - REMOTE

Duration: 6+ Months

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior DDI Engineer and this role involves designing and implementing advanced DNS, DHCP, and IPAM solutions across global networks. You will work with expert network architects and engineers to enhance our network reliability and scalability.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop and manage global distributed infrastructure for network monitoring and automation.
  • Lead the design and implementation of DDI solutions to improve network reliability and scalability.
  • Collaborate with network teams to integrate network SRE solutions.
  • Conduct network analysis and configuration management to enhance system performance.
  • Manage network SRE products, including new hardware system design and delivery.
  • Define and implement recovery strategies for network infrastructure.
  • Foster continuous improvement and support a zero-fault culture.

Qualifications:

  • Undergraduate degree in engineering or computer science, or equivalent experience.
  • 10 years of experience in IT with a focus on DDI solutions for mission-critical networks.
  • Experience with DDI appliance technologies from vendors like Infoblox, BlueCat, etc.
  • Proficiency in configuring SaaS-based DDI solutions from AWS, Azure, and others.
  • Experience in DNS security policies, DNS resolution, and DHCP configuration.
  • Strong scripting skills for automating DDI tasks.
  • Experience with cloud computing platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure).
  • Familiarity with Agile methodologies and network solution documentation.

Preferred Skills:

  • Advanced degree in a technical discipline or MBA with a focus on technology.
  • Experience in the hospitality industry is a plus.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Excellent communication skills for diverse audiences.

title: IT Technical Support Analyst :: Richmond, VA (Onsite)
description:
IT Technical Support Analyst - Richmond, VA

Duration: 6+ months | Onsite

We are seeking a dedicated Technical Support Analyst to join our team. This role involves providing exceptional helpdesk support and managing ticketing systems to resolve technical issues efficiently. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in hardware and software troubleshooting, telecom and mobile device management, and application installation and configuration.

  • Helpdesk Support & Ticketing Systems: Proficient in evaluating, routing, prioritizing, and resolving technical issues using helpdesk platforms.
  • Hardware & Software Troubleshooting: Hands-on experience with desktops, laptops, printers, AV equipment, and peripheral devices.
  • Telecom & Mobile Device Management: Skilled in managing desk phones, cell phones, and cellular connectivity, including troubleshooting and reconciliation.
  • Application Installation & Configuration: Experience installing and configuring software applications across various systems.
  • Inventory & Asset Management: Maintains accurate records of IT assets and supports inventory reconciliation.

Soft Skills & Professional Strengths:

  • Customer Service & Communication: Strong ability to communicate technical information clearly to non-technical users across all staff levels.
  • Team Collaboration: Works effectively in team environments and supports colleagues as needed, including acting as a backup for key roles.
  • Problem Solving & Escalation Management: Capable of resolving issues independently and escalating appropriately when necessary.
  • Reporting & Documentation: Prepares weekly reports and maintains detailed documentation of support activities and procedures.
  • Training & User Support: Provides training and guidance to end users and staff on IT systems and processes as needed.

Must-Have Skills:

  • Telecommunications skills (POTS lines, VoIP, and cell)
  • A/V Systems Support
  • Helpdesk - Accurately log and resolve tickets. Serve as a point of contact. Escalate when necessary (2 Years)
  • Customer Oriented and Team Player (3 Years)
  • Computer diagnostics and remediation (3 Years)
  • Strong ability to effectively communicate (3 Years)
  • Additional duties as needed.

title: IT Finance Manager :: Tallahassee, FL (Onsite)
description:
IT Finance Manager

Location: Tallahassee, FL

Duration: 8 months, Onsite

Join our team to provide financial management for the Office of Information Technology. You'll lead the analysis, development, and implementation of financial services for IT planning and control.

Scope of Services:

We are looking for a highly motivated, self-starter, independent worker with excellent communication, organizational, and critical thinking skills.

Primary Job Duties/Tasks:

  • Analyze IT financial conditions and develop recommendations for senior IT leadership.
  • Provide financial statements such as monthly budgets and summary reports.
  • Review and approve deliverables for contract and purchase order payments.
  • Develop financial metrics and conduct reviews to ensure compliance.
  • Drive standard accounting practices, reconciliations, and consistent reporting.
  • Ensure compliance with Statutes, Administrative Code, and internal policies.
  • Create user guides, process documentation, and self-service resources.
  • Implement automated feedback collection and analysis procedures.
  • Develop continuous improvement workflows and enhancement tracking systems.
  • Complete daily reporting activities.

Job Specific Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities (KSAs):

  • Knowledge of financial management principles and practices, particularly in IT environments.
  • Knowledge of IT budgeting processes, cost accounting, and financial planning methodologies.
  • Knowledge of government procurement regulations and compliance requirements.
  • Skill in advanced financial analysis and modeling capabilities.
  • Ability to lead complex financial analysis projects from conception to implementation.
  • Ability to communicate complex financial concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Experience:

  • 5-7 years of financial management experience, including managing teams responsible for economic analysis, planning, cost analysis, and financial statements.
  • Experience with Florida Statewide Financial Management Systems.
  • Experience with Florida legislative budget processes.

Education:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or another related field.
